name: Detect Empty Workflow Outputs with an Optional Keptick Receipt
description: Check distinct completed-record IDs, including empty and malformed output. Run a fictional local demo without an account; optionally send a count-only receipt to Keptick.

parameters.content:
## Check the output, including zero
Run the demo without an account or network request. In Configure check, change demoCase from healthy to empty, invalid, or duplicates. Inspect the last node.

The sample records are fictional. This checks distinct nonempty IDs in one field, not whether the real business work was correct.

## Connect your real output
1. Keep Configure check before your processing steps.
2. Replace Fictional completed outputs with the node that emits completed records. Enable Always Output Data on that node, so Check completed outputs runs when there are none.
3. Set recordIdField and minimumItems for that output.
4. Test healthy, empty, invalid and duplicate results.

Errors before this branch and workflows that never start require a separate error workflow or missing-run monitor. A run that never reaches the check sends no receipt.

## Optional receipt
Create a monitor in [Keptick](https://keptick.aifirm.app/guide?utm_source=github&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=e08_n8n_output_guard), paste its private receipt URL in Configure check, then set sendReceipt to true. Keep testReceipt true during setup; set false for real work.

Only counts/status and an execution identifier leave n8n. The private URL is a credential: do not share workflow exports or execution data after adding it. HTTP errors stop the receipt branch; no automatic retries. The local check works without Keptick.

Made by Keptick, with AI assistance. No affiliation with n8n.
